purpose: A presentation-variety layer that sits on top of the D4 house style without changing D4's rendering language. It supplies deterministic, per-hobby guidance across nine dimensions (gender presentation, age presentation, face/hair presentation, body build, composition, lighting time, palette mood, emotional mode, effects intensity) so that thousands of catalog cards do not converge on the same young-female / dark-straight-hair / golden-hour / medium-shot / smiling / sparkly default. Selection is a stable per-dimension hash of the hobby recipe id, so it is reproducible across regenerations, not random. Dimensions may carry a 'weights' map for a non-uniform deterministic split (used for effects_intensity); dimensions without 'weights' are picked uniformly. A hobby_overrides_v1.json entry may set 'diversity_lock' to pin one or more dimensions when the hobby's own semantics require it; hobby-specific recognition/must_include requirements always take priority over this guidance if the two ever conflict. This is presentation variety only - it never infers protected characteristics from hobby identity, and it must never force an implausible age/build/context.

values.male_led: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a male-presenting protagonist.
values.female_led: If a person is the clear main subject, let them read as a female-presenting protagonist.
values.mixed_group: If multiple people appear, mix genders and presentations naturally rather than defaulting to a single uniform type.

values.younger_adult: Let the protagonist read as a younger adult, appropriate and non-sexualized.
values.adult: Let the protagonist read as a person in their thirties, an ordinary adult rather than a teen or student.
values.middle_aged_adult: Let the protagonist read as a middle-aged adult (roughly forties to fifties).
values.older_adult: Let the protagonist read as a mature or older adult rather than defaulting to a young adult.

values.short_neat_hair: Give the protagonist short, neat hair rather than long flowing hair, and a rounder or softer face shape.
values.long_straight_hair: Give the protagonist long straight hair and an oval face shape.
values.wavy_medium_hair: Give the protagonist wavy, medium-length hair and a softer jawline.
values.curly_or_coily_hair: Give the protagonist curly or coily-textured hair, distinct from straight anime-default hair.
values.buzzed_or_very_short_hair: Give the protagonist buzzed or very short cropped hair and a more angular jawline.
values.tied_back_practical_hair: Give the protagonist hair tied back or bundled up in a practical style suited to the activity, with a squarer or more defined jaw.
values.grey_or_silver_hair: Give the protagonist grey, silver, or visibly greying hair rather than a uniform youthful hair colour.
values.warm_toned_hair: Give the protagonist a warm hair tone such as auburn, chestnut, or reddish-brown rather than plain black hair.

values.slim: Give the protagonist a slim, lean build.
values.average: Give the protagonist an average, everyday build.
values.athletic: Give the protagonist a visibly athletic, toned build appropriate to the activity.
values.broader_build: Give the protagonist a broader, sturdier build, rendered naturally and without caricature.
values.mature_build: Give the protagonist a build appropriate to a mature adult, rendered naturally and without caricature.

values.close_action: Use a close, intimate action framing rather than a standard medium shot.
values.medium_hero_shot: Use a classic medium hero shot.
values.wide_environmental_hero: Use a wide environmental framing that gives real visual weight to the surrounding space.
values.group_interaction: Favor a small-group interaction moment (three or more people) rather than a solo portrait.
values.object_hero: Let the key object or piece of equipment itself be the hero of the frame, with any person secondary.
values.environment_hero: Let the environment or setting carry as much visual weight as the subject, rather than a tight character-only portrait.

values.bright_daylight: Light the scene with bright, clear daylight.
values.cool_daylight: Light the scene with cool, neutral daylight rather than warm golden tones.
values.soft_morning: Light the scene with soft early-morning light.
values.golden_hour: Light the scene with warm golden-hour light.
values.blue_hour: Light the scene with the cool blue tones of dusk (blue hour).
values.evening_interior: Light the scene as a warm evening interior.
values.night_neon: Light the scene at night, with artificial or neon-like light accents where the setting realistically allows it.

values.warm_palette: Favor an overall warm color palette.
values.cool_palette: Favor an overall cool color palette.
values.complementary_palette: Use a mixed, complementary color palette rather than a single dominant hue family.
values.high_key: Use a bright, high-key palette with light, airy tones.
values.subdued_colorful: Use a subdued but still colorful palette rather than a saturated, poster-bright one.

values.joy: The emotional mode should read as joyful and light.
values.concentration: The emotional mode should read as focused concentration rather than an open smile.
values.curiosity: The emotional mode should read as curious and inquisitive.
values.excitement: The emotional mode should read as excited and energized.
values.calm_satisfaction: The emotional mode should read as calm, satisfied contentment.
values.tension: The emotional mode should read as alert tension or suspense appropriate to the activity.
values.discovery: The emotional mode should read as a moment of discovery or realization.
values.mastery: The emotional mode should read as confident mastery and skill rather than a big grin.
values.friendship_connection: The emotional mode should read as warm friendship or connection between people.

values.zero_effects: Render this artwork with NO sparkles, no floating glowing particles, no magical glints, no decorative light flecks, and no aura-like glow effects anywhere in the image. Ordinary physically plausible highlights, reflections, and light sources (sun glare, lamp light, water reflections, polished-surface shine) are still allowed - only decorative/magical-feeling sparkle and particle effects are prohibited.
values.minimal_effects: Keep special-effect accents very subtle and physically motivated: at most a few restrained highlights, small glints off a genuinely reflective surface, or light dust/mist consistent with the real environment - nothing showy, no obvious decorative sparkle trails.
values.accent_effects: Tasteful D4 special-moment energy accents (rim light, small glints, a light sparkle trail at the decisive action beat) are welcome here to heighten the collectible feel, used with restraint rather than covering the whole frame.
